name: @workspace.sh/table-app
description: What an app around the .table views does, on any platform: bundle keys, a viewer's arrangements, display settings, saved state, archives, and a React binding (./react).

@formatjs/intl-locale.comment: Only for the ./intl subpath: Hermes's missing Intl pieces, for relative dates.

@formatjs/intl-pluralrules.comment: Only for the ./intl subpath: Hermes's missing Intl pieces, for relative dates.

@formatjs/intl-relativetimeformat.comment: Only for the ./intl subpath: Hermes's missing Intl pieces, for relative dates.

@op-engineering/op-sqlite.comment: Only for the ./mac-index-host subpath: the Mac's files and SQLite.

react.comment: Only for the ./react subpath (useTableApp). The rest of table-app is renderer-free.

react-native.comment: Only for the ./embed-view subpath (its frame and dialog) and ./formula-engine (the JSI module) on iOS, Android and macOS. The web takes embedView.web.tsx, and the rest of table-app is renderer-free.

react-native-file-access.comment: Only for the ./mac-index-host subpath: the Mac's files and SQLite.

react-strict-dom.comment: Only for the ./embed-view subpath (table-ui's views, the caption and the reason).
